# Sirach Chapter 44 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 44 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_044_page_001.jpg

---

44:1 Let us now praise famous men, and our fathers in their generations.

44:2 The Lord apportioned to them great glory, his majesty from the beginning.

44:3 Those who ruled in their kingdoms, men renowned for their power, giving counsel by their understanding, and proclaiming prophecies;

44:4 leaders of the people in their deliberations and in understanding of learning for the people, wise in their words of instruction;

44:5 those who composed musical tunes, and set forth verses in writing;

44:6 rich men endowed with strength, living at peace in their dwelling places —

44:7 all these were honored in their generations, and were a glory in their days.

44:8 There are some of them who have left a name behind them, so that their praise might be recounted.

44:9 And there are some who have no memorial, who have perished as though they had not existed; they have become as though they had not been born, and so have their children after them.

44:10 But these were men of mercy, whose righteous deeds have not been forgotten.

44:11 With their seed their good things will remain; their inheritance is to their children's children.

44:12 Their seed stands fast in the covenants, and their children also, for their sakes.

44:13 Their seed will endure forever, and their glory will not be blotted out.

44:14 Their bodies were buried in peace, and their name lives to every generation.

44:15 Peoples will declare their wisdom, and the assembly proclaims their praise.

44:16 Enoch pleased the Lord and was taken up, an example of repentance to all generations.

44:17 Noah was found perfect and righteous; in the time of wrath he became the compensation; therefore a remnant was left for the earth when the flood came.

44:18 Everlasting covenants were made with him, that all flesh should not be blotted out by a flood.

44:19 Abraham was the great father of a multitude of nations, and no one has been found like him in glory.

44:20 He kept the law of the Most High, and entered into covenant with him; he established the covenant in his flesh, and when he was tested he was found faithful.

44:21 Therefore the Lord assured him by an oath that the nations would be blessed through his seed; that he would multiply him like the dust of the earth, and exalt his seed like the stars, and cause them to inherit from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.

44:22 To Isaac also he granted the same assurance, for the sake of Abraham his father; the blessing of all men and the covenant he made to rest upon the head of Jacob.

44:23 He acknowledged him in his blessings and gave him inheritance; he divided his portions and distributed them among twelve tribes.
